description: Access skill for the Beijing Education Examination Authority website (www.bjeea.cn).

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - fetch_announcement   Fetch and parse a BJEEA announcement page, extracting tables, links, and metadata
  - search_announcements   Search for admission-related announcements by category and year

max_rows.description: Maximum number of table rows to return (default: all rows)

category.description: Announcement category (gkgz=高考高招, zkzz=中考中招)
